text: Senior QB Malachi Singleton posted three passing touchdowns in Appalachian State's 55-3 win against Maine on Sept. 5, tied for the most passing touchdowns in the Sun Belt Conference this week.
Appalachian State posted 348 passing yards in its 55-3 win against Maine on Sept. 5, the third-most passing yards in a game in the Sun Belt Conference this season so far.
Appalachian State posted 29 pass completions in its 55-3 win against Maine on Sept. 5, the second-most pass completions in a game in the Sun Belt Conference this season so far.

Sophomore QB KJ Jackson posted three passing touchdowns in Arkansas' 31-14 win against North Alabama on Sept. 5, the second-most passing TDs in a game in the Southeastern Conference among sophomore players this season so far. The last Razorback to match three passing TDs was KJ Jefferson in 2021.
Senior WR Chris Marshall posted seven receptions in Arkansas' 31-14 win against North Alabama on Sept. 5, tied for the most receptions in the Southeastern Conference among senior players this week.
